## Issues

Shared history contains concurrent Mumford, Milne, and AJCR commits; none were incorporated into the Hartshorne commits.

## Why I Stopped

This verified unit is complete, while the standing task must remain active. `fs-hartshorne` is still `running` and `Hartshorne.iv3-chart-gluing` remains active.

## Next

For a fixed finite basis, prove every closed point has a basis coordinate with nonzero jump and exact divisor order. Then construct its regularized denominator opens, prove they cover, and pass the indexed family to `gluedFromOpen`. The geometric base-point-free and very-ample equivalences remain subsequent work.
